workflow: Compound-specific comparison of observed mechanisms and denominators.
evidence_basis: Case descriptions §§2.2–2.3. Subject 2 received lysine with fortified protein at 10 months while already severely affected; continued to decline and died at 14 months. Subject 3 started combined regimen at 5 years after seizure control with clobazam, cannabidiol and valproate. Valproate was discontinued after three months; family-reported skills and sleep gains during ongoing therapies, seizures chiefly during illness or missed medication. No evidence that lysine initiated seizure control or that failure/success was causally attributable to supplementation.
